narrative.overview: Warm Filipino-first price lookup, purple typography, lilac answers, and apricot speech actions. Shared native theme extends through existing store workflows. Persistent top Offline badge removed. Source checks passed; native rendering remains unverified.
keyCharacteristics: Visible capture, correction, and owner review

rules.name: Answer First
rules.body: Keep product, variant, unit, and price readable together; wrap real content.

rules.name: State Clarity
rules.body: Pair colors with state text and selected accessibility state; preserve uncertainty and recovery.

dos: Preserve speech correction and owner confirmation.
Verify native rendering and accessibility on Android.
donts: Don't restore the redundant top Offline badge.
Don't insert mockup products into persistence.
Don't treat previews or bundle export as native visual verification.
